'''Denis-Charles Cisinski''' (born March 10, 1976) is a [[mathematician]] focussing on [[higher category theory]], [[homotopy theory]], [[K-theory]] and [[algebraic geometry]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Denis-Charles Cisinski |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Denis-Charles-Cisinski |access-date=2024-10-10 |website=researchgate.net}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Denis-Charles Cisinski |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=TewShjUAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2024-10-10 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> In 2001, [[Cisinski model structure|Cisinski model structures]] on [[Topos|topoi]] were introduced and later named after him. Since 2016, Denis-Charles Cisinski works at the [[Universität Regensburg]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
Denis-Charles Cisinski obtained his [[PhD]] in 2002 at the [[Paris Diderot University]] with a thesis supervised by Georges Maltsiniotis and titled ''Les préfaisceaux comme modèles des types d'homotopie'' ([[Presheaves]] as models for [[homotopy type]]s).<ref>{{cite web |title=Denis-Charles Cisinski - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=74126 |access-date=2024-10-10}}</ref> It was expanded and released as a book in 2006, further developing the theory from ''[[Pursuing Stacks]]'' by [[Alexander Grothendieck]]. In 2015, Denis-Charles Cisinski gave a talk at the [[Séminaire Nicolas Bourbaki]] summarizing the current state of research titled ''Catégories supérieures et théorie des topos'' (Higher categories and theory of toposes).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Association des collaborateurs de Nicolas Bourbaki |url=https://www.bourbaki.fr/seminaires/ |access-date=2024-10-13 |website=www.bourbaki.fr}}</ref> ''[[Higher Categories and Homotopical Algebra]]'', a mathematical textbook about higher category theory by Denis-Charles Cisinski, was published in 2019.
